en: A black-and-white aerial photograph showing a small industrial settlement nestled in a wooded valley. Prominent in the foreground are several large factory buildings with tall smokestacks emitting smoke. Surrounding the factory are smaller residential houses, gardens, and a few other buildings. In the right-center, a building prominently displays the text 'Barchfeld Meur.', possibly an abbreviation. There is a railway or road running along the bottom edge of the image, with forested hills in the background.
